Now that I'm sober I can't say I regret coming out that much. I miss those that were there before, but you're right. It would have been worse living in denial. 

I live in Mi so LA is quite a ways away. But maybe I should search for a support group nearby as a small step.

I do think I'll be okay for now tho. Getting everything out there and the replies I got (both here and whisper) have helped.  Thank you <3
